<thought>To determine the number of methyl groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample, which lists the distinct carbon environments. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (~10‑30 ppm). By counting how many signals fall in that region, I can infer the number of methyl groups.</thought>
